title.en: The compass: circle, disc and radius

concept.hr: Šestar drži jedan razmak: sve točke kružnice jednako su daleko od središta
concept.en: A compass keeps one distance: each point of a circle is that far from the centre

summary.hr: Otvori šestar i nacrtaj kružnicu, odluči je li T unutar, na ili izvan nje, pa šestarom prenesi stranice i konstruiraj pravokutnik.
summary.en: Open the compass and draw a circle, decide if T is inside, on or outside it, then carry the sides with the compass to build a rectangle.

title.hr: Pripada li T kružnici? Krug i kružnica
title.en: Does T belong to the circle? Disc and circle

concept.hr: Krug je kružnica sa svime unutar nje; kružnica je samo rubna crta
concept.en: A disc is the circle with all inside it; the circle is only its edge

title.en: A rectangle with given sides, by compass

concept.hr: Šestar prenosi duljinu stranice bez ponovnog mjerenja
concept.en: The compass carries a side's length with no measuring again
